skill_name: Describe the major themes in Oedipus Rex by Sophocles
workflow: The major themes in Sophocles’ Oedipus Rex are those of fate, hubris, and individual responsibility. Oedipus is a classic tragic hero who suffers a great downfall due to his hubris, or excessive pride. He is determined to solve the riddle of his own identity, despite warnings from oracles, and in so doing, discovers he has unknowingly fulfilled a terrible prophecy.
